description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function for compiling a modifier that counts paragraphs in a text. It includes the function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_count_paragraphs' which generates PHP code to count line breaks.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_count_paragraphs
methods.description: Generates PHP code to count the number of paragraphs by counting line break characters in the input parameter.
